name: Taking the Bait Back

faq.answer: A Lost One fisherman emerged from the muck, severed Pelluk's fishing line, and fled with the lure to use along the eastern banks.
The Lost Ones fish along the water banks directly east of Pelluk's camp.
faq.q: Where can the thief be found?

aliases: why does pelluk need the lure
faq.answer: Pelluk relies on the lure to catch fish, and he fears his camp will starve without their regular catch.
faq.q: Why does Pelluk need his lucky lure returned?

sections.body: Pelluk was fishing in the marsh when a creature rose from the muck, severed his line, and fled with his prized lure. He suspects a Lost One fisherman took it to work the water banks to the east. Without that tackle, he cannot land another catch, and his camp risks running out of food.
sections.title: A Cut Line

summary: A thief has stolen Pelluk's prized fishing lure right off his line. He relies on that tackle to feed his camp, and he wants you to track down the creature along the eastern waters.
attribution: In-game quest text: Taking the Bait Back
